instruction: Save the stock data table as CSV, then implement Python code to calculate the overall revenue for all companies (in billions) and write it to 'result.txt'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting stock.xlsx to CSV, writing Python code to calculate total revenue across all companies in billions, and saving result to result.txt. Verified with Python: processed all 37 companies with revenue data, converting M/B suffixes to billions - total revenue = 183.15B. Multi-step evaluator: (1) checks CSV file exists on Desktop (30% weight), (2) checks Python script exists on Desktop (30% weight), (3) verifies numeric result in result.txt with tolerance of 1.0 billion (40% weight). This ensures users follow the complete workflow instead of bypassing CSV export and Python coding steps.
